steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In January 2024, Equity Mates explained Dropsuite was a cloud backup, archiving and recovery software platform focused on business continuity and compliance for businesses.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In March 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said worries about Microsoft launching its own backup eased because large institutions prefer a third‑party provider to protect data, and the market for backup remained massively underpenetrated despite competition.
